# v1.0.0-preview.1 — Jeninnet.Validation

**Status:** preview
**Target:** .NET 11.0 (STS)
**Language:** C# 15
**License:** MIT

## Overview

The first preview of Jeninnet.Validation, targeting .NET 11 (STS). It ships the complete feature
set — generated and fluent validators, localization, metadata, integrations, and tooling — with a
C# 15 build and 25 NuGet packages.

## Packages (25)

| Package | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Jeninnet.Validation` | Core engine + fluent API |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.Abstractions` | Contracts and value types |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.Analyzers` | Source generator + misuse analyzers |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.Assertions` | Stack-agnostic test assertions |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.Localization` | Built-in message packs for 40 cultures |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.Localization.AspNetCore` | IStringLocalizer/resx bridge |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.AspNetCore` | Minimal API + MVC integration |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.Extensions.Validation` | Microsoft.Extensions.Validation bridge |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.JsonSchema` | JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) generation |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.OpenApi` | OpenAPI schema constraints |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.OpenApi.Swashbuckle` | OpenAPI constraints for Swashbuckle |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.OpenApi.NSwag` | OpenAPI constraints for NSwag/NJsonSchema |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.ClientRules` | Client-side rule export (JSON/TS/JS) |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.Rules.Domain` | Optional domain rules (IBAN, VAT, postal code, national ID) |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.Diagnostics` | OpenTelemetry-compatible tracing and metrics |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.MediatR` | MediatR validation pipeline |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.MediatR.ErrorOr` | MediatR ErrorOr result adapter |
| `Jeninnet.Validation.MediatR.FluentResults` | MediatR FluentResults result adapter |

## Highlights

- **.NET 11 target.** Every shipping library targets `net11.0`; the analyzer targets
  `netstandard2.0`. `Jeninnet.Validation.DataAnnotations` and
  `Jeninnet.Validation.Extensions.Validation` ship `lib/net11.0`.
- **C# 15.** The solution builds with the .NET 11 SDK and `LangVersion=15.0`.
- **.NET 11 validation API.** The `Microsoft.Extensions.Validation` adapter implements
  `IValidatableTypeInfo`/`IValidatableParameterInfo`, so minimal-API parameter validation works
  on .NET 11.
- Attribute-driven and fluent validators share one engine and are pinned by executable parity tests.
- Rule sets, cascade modes, fail-fast, per-rule conditions, dependent rules, custom rules with
  context, collection counts/filters, and dedicated format rules.
- Frozen validator descriptors feed JSON Schema, OpenAPI, and client-rule emission.
- Optional integrations for ASP.NET Core, MediatR (ErrorOr, FluentResults,
  CSharpFunctionalExtensions), DataAnnotations, Blazor, GraphQL, and gRPC.
- NativeAOT smoke harness, benchmark evidence, and a zero-allocation happy-path audit.
- Optional input sanitization (`Sanitize`/`[Sanitize]`) and the `jeninnet` migration
  assistant for FluentValidation/DataAnnotations codebases.

## Quality

- 997 tests passing on `net11.0`; build 0 warnings / 0 errors.
- SonarCloud quality gate: 80.2% coverage, 0.0% duplicated lines, 0 open issues.
- ReportGenerator all-assembly baseline: 79.1% line / 65.2% branch / 84.6% method across 25
  assemblies (2026-11-12).
- AOT/trimming analyzers clean; smoke harness publishes and runs in CI.

## Known limitations

- DataAnnotations and Blazor adapters are synchronous; the .NET 11 async DataAnnotations and
  async Options bridges are planned for `1.1.0-preview.1`.
- The OpenAPI transformer uses JSON property names; custom naming policies may need explicit
  registration.
